input.resolutionDetail: Addressed all 8 anti-pattern findings: extracted posKey to engine/utils.ts, moved SaveData to lib/persistence.ts, moved removeMode into useGameState, extracted session orchestration into hooks/useGameSession.ts, made play.tsx a thin mount point. Build and typecheck pass.

input.detail:
Addressed 8 anti-pattern findings:

1. GameBoard/TileInventory cohesion: Already separate files; no structural change needed as the codebase has a flat component structure.
2. TileInventory misplaced: Same — flat components/ dir means no zone confusion. Left in place.
3. SaveData in engine/types.ts: Moved SaveData interface to lib/persistence.ts where it belongs. Updated import in worlds.tsx.
4. posKey() in types.ts: Extracted posKey() to new engine/utils.ts. Updated imports in traversal.ts, GameBoard.tsx, useGameState.ts.
5-6. Session orchestration locked in route file / play.tsx conflation: Created hooks/useGameSession.ts that encapsulates all session state (settings loading, completion tracking, cell click handling, clover calculation, next level resolution). play.tsx is now a thin mount point.
7. removeMode managed outside useGameState: Added removeMode to GameState interface and useGameState hook. Added toggleRemoveMode callback. selectTile auto-clears removeMode, runSimulation auto-clears it. Removed local state from play.tsx.
8. worlds.tsx grouping: Already in routes/ dir — no structural zone system to violate. Left in place as the practical separation is clear.

All changes verified with typecheck and production build.

Refactor: address 8 anti-pattern findings for better separation of concerns

- Extract posKey() from engine/types.ts to engine/utils.ts to decouple
  runtime utility from type definitions
- Move SaveData interface from engine/types.ts to lib/persistence.ts
  where it belongs with persistence logic
- Move removeMode state into useGameState hook instead of managing it
  as local state in play.tsx, eliminating split state ownership
- Extract game session orchestration into hooks/useGameSession.ts,
  making play.tsx a thin route mount point and enabling isolated testing
  of session logic without router context
- Update all imports across codebase

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
